artifact: paired A/B of Civilization native (Orion) memory on vs. off
collected_by: Civilization v1 evaluation run; reproduction script in scripts/memory_ab.py
paired_design: Same text, answer options, task name, session memory contents, provider model, and seed; only CivilizationRequest.read_memory differs. write_memory=False in both conditions. Condition order alternates by case.
scoring: Exact match to a synthetic answer key; no LLM judge.
limitations: There are 25 unique synthetic questions; the three repeats measure repeatability, not 75 independent question samples.
The ordinary prediction endpoint receives fixed-choice questions, not free-form conversation or automatic memory-extraction tasks.
Session store persistence across process restart and global-memory behavior are outside this comparison.
No-memory calls can still guess from the question or option wording; report paired wins and losses rather than interpreting the raw accuracy delta alone.
